pages.title: Tube Jam Puzzle
pages.creator: Zogambo
pages.description: Manage the flow of colored balls in Tube Jam Puzzle. Hold a dispenser to release balls onto a conveyor and fill boxes of the matching color. Switch between tubes and leave enough belt space for moving balls, since overfilling the conveyor creates a jam.

pages.title: Cake Merge 2
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Complete desserts from matching slices in Cake Merge 2. Place plates on the tray so identical slices touch and combine into whole cakes. Finished cakes disappear, freeing space for new plates, while plates holding several colors require planning around more than one possible match.

pages.title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Take a sniper's role in Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D. Aim through the first-person view and use the available firearms to complete combat assignments. Locating enemies and lining up an accurate shot form the core of each battlefield encounter.

pages.title: Avenger Guard
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Rebuild your homeland's defenses in Avenger Guard. Merge heroes to create stronger fighters, arrange the squad, and repel approaching enemy waves. Invest in fortifications and further fusions as the defenders work toward reclaiming the territory taken by the attackers.

pages.title: Car Destruction King
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Put vehicles through destructive driving challenges in Car Destruction King. Race across maps equipped with rotating hammers, presses, and catapults, experimenting with stunts and crashes. Use nitro, braking, or slow motion to handle the obstacles and pursue better results in the available modes.

pages.title: Diamond Solitaire Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear a jewel-themed tile layout in Diamond Solitaire Mahjong. Find matching pieces and remove pairs, earning more points by making matches quickly. Zoom the single puzzle board in or out to inspect its diamonds and gems while working toward clearing the arrangement.

pages.title: Larry World
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Guide Larry through four platforming worlds in Larry World. Move around each stage with the directional controls and work through the route ahead. Collect the required power-up to gain a shooting attack, then use Space to fire during the adventure.

pages.title: Cowboys Duel
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Test your quick draw in Cowboys Duel. Face the computer alone or challenge a friend to a cowboy showdown, reacting at the right moment to fire. Mouse clicks or taps control the duel as you try to beat the opposing gunslinger to the shot.

pages.title: Roblo X Zombie
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Prepare for successive zombie attacks in Roblo X Zombie. Gather supplies, collect useful materials, and construct barricades around the survivor's position. Upgrade the defenses between waves so the next undead group has more resistance to overcome before reaching you.

pages.title: Pushover 3D
pages.creator: Gameloops
pages.description: Draw a fighter's movement in Pushover 3D. Sketch curves that turn into ragdoll actions, sending the character into spins, leaps, and collisions with an opponent. Experiment with different line shapes to produce a motion that wins the physics-based fight.

pages.title: Tank Stars Battle Arena
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Build fighting vehicles in Tank Stars Battle Arena. Arrange functional tank parts and send the design into battle, winning by defeating the opposing pilot. Earn diamonds for chests containing more components, and save up to three designs while working through fourteen levels.

pages.title: Push It 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Push crates onto marked spaces in Push It 3D. Work out how to move the boxes through each three-dimensional layout without losing the route to their destinations. Completing the required placements clears the puzzle and opens another arrangement of boxes to solve.

pages.title: Road Chase. Shooter Realistic Guns
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Stop the vehicles pursuing you in Road Chase. Shooter Realistic Guns. Aim with the mouse while the weapon fires automatically, attacking motorcycles, cars, ATVs, and helicopters. Clear every pursuer in the level and choose from an arsenal that includes an AK47, crossbow, and minigun.

pages.title: Fennec The Fox Click Adventure
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Develop a desert fox into a space traveler in Fennec The Fox Click Adventure. Tap to make progress and unlock upgrades that change Fennec's capabilities. Continue through new worlds and challenges as the character evolves toward journeys farther from the desert.

pages.title: 2020 Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Place equal-numbered blocks beside one another in 2020 Connect. A connected group of at least four merges into a higher value, opening space for another arrangement. Larger groups award coins for boosters as you work toward creating an 8192 block.

pages.title: Music Rush
pages.creator: Canvas Ink Games
pages.description: Guide a music star through a rhythmic endless run in Music Rush. Use one-tap actions to keep advancing while the song and setting develop with your score. Explore fifteen original tracks across different genres and use power-ups during the climb toward a higher career stage.

pages.title: Planet Demolish
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Destroy worlds with a selection of disasters and weapons in Planet Demolish. Choose a tool and strike the planet to fill its damage meter until it explodes. Complete stages and earn batteries to unlock additional destructive tools for later planets.

pages.title: New Year Makeup Trends
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create three festive beauty looks in New Year Makeup Trends. Help Olivia with jeweled makeup, give Ellie an eyeliner-focused style, and build Kiki's look around shimmering eyeshadow. Choose the finishing details for each character before completing their preparations for the year-end party.

pages.title: Construction Ramp Jumping
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Launch heavy equipment into destructive landings in Construction Ramp Jumping. Send vehicles such as a roadroller off ramps and into buildings, using their weight to smash through the scenery. Try the different vehicles and locations to create another large collision.

pages.title: Fish Stab Getting Big
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight for size beneath the waves in Fish Stab Getting Big. Steer a fish with a blade in its mouth and stab rivals to earn points. Each kill makes both the fish and its sword grow, with solo and two-player modes available.

pages.title: Lofys - Numbers
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Explore number activities in Lofys - Numbers. Work through exercises about number names, written forms, shapes, and quantities, selecting answers within each activity. More than forty exercises present different ways to connect the displayed numbers with what they represent.

pages.title: Merge To Battle
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Capture enemy strongholds in Merge To Battle. Combine pairs of warriors to create stronger units, improve their armor, and send them into real-time battles. Build and upgrade your own castle while preparing an army capable of taking the castles farther along the route.

pages.title: Relaxing Puzzle Match
pages.creator: Massive Core
pages.description: Clear colored groups in Relaxing Puzzle Match. Arrange moving tiles into horizontal or vertical matches, removing nearby block tiles through those combinations. Use boosters to undo a move or alter a tile's color when the current board needs a different approach.

pages.title: Tower Defense Clash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Protect a kingdom from invading monsters in Tower Defense Clash. Build towers along their route and survive the incoming waves. Combine arrow and stone attacks with elemental effects when the enemy groups require more than the initial defenses can handle.

pages.title: Rainbow Rocket Ninja
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Draw an attack route for a fast-moving fighter in Rainbow Rocket Ninja. Trace a trajectory that carries the blue ninja through the enemies placed around the scene. Choose a path that reaches the targets and uses the character's weapons to clear the stage.

pages.title: Catwalk Girl Challenge
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Dress for the runway's current theme in Catwalk Girl Challenge. Select clothing during each level and build a look that fits the requested style. Judges score the finished outfits, with the higher-scoring contestant winning the fashion walk.

pages.title: Ninja Hands
pages.creator: YSO Corp
pages.description: Rescue captured girls using supernatural attacks in Ninja Hands. Confront enemies with abilities that include fireballs, thrown shurikens, and sword strikes. Choose an attack for the threats ahead and use the ninja's powers to clear the way to the people needing help.

pages.title: Russian Draughts
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Outmaneuver the opposing pieces in Russian Draughts. Choose moves that capture the other side's checkers while protecting your own position. Win by removing all opposing pieces or leaving the opponent without a legal move on their turn.

pages.title: Escape From Nightmare
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Find a way out of a dark dream in Escape From Nightmare. Guide the character through ten platforming stages, judging the route from one landing to the next. Completing each section brings you farther through the nightmare toward its exit.

pages.title: Splitter
pages.creator: IceStone
pages.description: Cut objects to guide a character toward the brown exit in Splitter. Slice the allowed shapes and let gravity move the resulting pieces, collecting stars when the route permits it. Different cuts can produce different solutions to the same physics puzzle.

pages.title: Ultimate Birds Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Plus Studios
pages.description: Lead a growing flock in Ultimate Birds Adventure. Move through the jungle and bring smaller groups of birds into your own, expanding the flock as you travel. Choose a bird appearance from the available skins before continuing the gathering challenge.

pages.title: Fairies Heart Style
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two friends as Cupid-inspired fairies in Fairies Heart Style. Choose airy dresses, heart-shaped accessories, hairstyles, and makeup for their festive challenge. Build a separate look for each friend while coordinating the clothing and beauty details around the holiday theme.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Lof Toons
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear faces from a spinning wheel in Bubble Shooter Lof Toons. Fire matching toons into groups of at least three of one color to remove them. The score decreases as time passes, so finish collecting the wheel's pieces before too many points are lost.

pages.title: Dr Octopus Darkling
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Lead a tentacled character out of a dark forest in Dr Octopus Darkling. Navigate the route while keeping clear of the poisonous water spread through the environment. Careful movement through the shadowy setting helps the doctor continue toward an escape.

pages.title: Monster Shooter Defense
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Defend the base from a moving marble chain in Monster Shooter Defense. Fire colored balls into matching groups of three or more to remove them. Keep breaking the chain before its leading balls reach the end of the route.

pages.title: Match Triple 3D Matching Tile
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tidy a room by collecting toy sets in Match Triple 3D Matching Tile. Select accessible objects from the top of the pile, bringing three identical items together to remove them. The collection area has limited space, so avoid filling it with pieces that cannot yet form a match.

pages.title: Fluffy Merge
pages.creator: Go Game Pte Ltd
pages.description: Clear creatures from a garden in Fluffy Merge. Select a Fluffie and slide to launch it into others of the same color, combining them through bouncing shots. Plan the angle to remove several creatures at once before the available moves run out.

pages.title: Prom Night Dressup
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Prepare a princess for an evening dance in Prom Night Dressup. Choose a dress and coordinate it with shoes, earrings, a necklace, and other accessories. Compare hairstyles and bags to finish the outfit before her appearance at the prom.

pages.title: Zombie Idle Defense Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hold a barricade against the undead in Zombie Idle Defense Online. Develop the survivor's defenses and use upgrades such as explosive barrels, healing kits, and air support during the fight. Replay stages to strengthen the position before facing another wave of zombies.

pages.title: Reflex Ball
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Rotate the central balls to intercept incoming colors in Reflex Ball. Match a ball arriving from above or below with the corresponding color in the middle. A wrong-color collision ends the run, while the increasing speed shortens the time available to react.

pages.title: 2 Foot Ball
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control two footballers at once in 2 Foot Ball. Drag on the screen to move the pair, collect the ball, and send it toward the opposing goal. Coordinate both players' movements to create a scoring opportunity without leaving the ball out of reach.

pages.title: Animal.io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Knock rival animals off a platform in Animal.io. Move around the arena and swing your tail to push opponents over the edge. Meat increases body size, hamburgers lengthen the tail, and mushrooms trade size for speed as you compete to remain on the platform.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dark Dimensions
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Clear a three-dimensional tile arrangement against the clock in Arkadium's Mahjongg Dark Dimensions. Find matching pieces and rotate through the layout to locate available pairs. Match Time Bonus Tiles to extend the countdown and keep the attempt going while working through the remaining tiles.

pages.title: Corona Cake Cooking
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create a novelty dessert in Corona Cake Cooking. Follow the cooking stages to make a virus-shaped cake, then choose decorations that continue the theme. Assemble the edible design and finish its details as part of the game's kitchen activity.

pages.title: Eat Numbers
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Guide a moving value toward smaller numbers in Eat Numbers. Consume eligible numbers to score, then check your changed value before choosing the next target. Move with the mouse and keep comparing the numbers around you as the conditions for a safe meal change.

pages.title: Turn Left
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Circle a track using a single steering direction in Turn Left. Hold the input to make the car turn left and release when it needs to continue along the route. Keep the vehicle on the course as you try to complete more laps.

pages.title: NERF Epic Pranks!
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stage foam-dart ambushes in NERF Epic Pranks! Fire a NERF blaster at opponents and hide when the situation calls for cover. Unlock more blasters, characters, and costumes as the pranks progress, including ninja, clown, and robot appearances.

pages.title: VR Roller Coaster
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Manage a train's pace along a ride in VR Roller Coaster. Adjust its speed as the track approaches sharp turns, steep slopes, loops, and inversions. Read the upcoming section and slow the train where the course requires more controlled movement.

pages.title: Animals Memo Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Reveal animal pictures in Animals Memo Match. Flip cards to find identical partners, remembering the positions of images that did not match on the first attempt. Continue selecting pairs until the hidden animal collection has been cleared from the board.

pages.title: Summer Beach Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore beach scenes in Summer Beach Slide. Choose one of three images and a puzzle mode, then slide the scrambled sections into their correct positions. Use the coastline and other picture details to work out the order of moves needed to complete the scene.

pages.title: Super Knight Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Lead an armed hero along an enemy-filled route in Super Knight Adventure. Approach opponents and strike with a spear or sword, then collect the trophies they leave behind. Continue moving through the adventure with the keyboard or on-screen directional buttons.

pages.title: Veterinary Doctor Escape 2
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Free a trapped veterinarian in Veterinary Doctor Escape 2. Search his house for hidden objects, examine clues, and solve the puzzles preventing his escape. Use each discovery with the relevant part of the room to open a way out for the doctor.

pages.title: Dangerous Speedway Cars
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive a car through obstacle courses in Dangerous Speedway Cars. Steer with the arrow keys and rotate the camera with the mouse to inspect the route. Judge the position of each barrier before continuing through the next section of the driving challenge.

pages.title: Penguin Bounce
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hit a penguin into a long-distance flight in Penguin Bounce. Control the polar bear's bat to launch it, then use helpful characters and bounces to travel farther. Upgrade the penguin and account for obstacles in different locations while pursuing a longer journey.

pages.title: Speedy Fish
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a fish between fishing hooks in Speedy Fish. Steer around the hanging hazards and collect sea stars along the route to earn points. Keep the fish swimming safely for as long as possible, using directional keys or the touch controls.

pages.title: Cube 3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Change a moving piece to fit the route ahead in Cube 3. Tap to switch its color or shape, matching the requirement of the approaching gate. Keep making the appropriate changes to continue the endless run without a mismatched collision.

pages.title: Fruit Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Remove marked cells by matching fruit in Fruit Match 3. Swap available pieces into rows or columns of at least three identical fruits, working around locked pieces that cannot move. Certain matching shapes create special symbols that help clear the remaining board.

pages.title: MF Dark Forest
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Battle magical skeletons in MF Dark Forest. Move through first-person combat missions, shoot enemies, and unlock additional weapons for the next encounter. Jump or slide to navigate the battlefield while switching firearms to deal with the threats around the masked fighter.

pages.title: Moto Speed GP
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle across different road settings in Moto Speed GP. Use the movement controls to guide the bike along each route and manage its direction through the road ahead. The game centers on maintaining control during its high-speed motorcycle drives.

pages.title: Car Defender
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Combine matching combat units in Car Defender to improve their firepower. Use the stronger shooters to defeat enemies threatening the vehicles, continuing to merge as more useful combinations become available. The defense depends on developing the units as well as stopping each attacking group.

pages.title: Crazy Victoria Secret Show
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help four princesses stage a winged fashion show in Crazy Victoria Secret Show. Choose outfits for Mia, Ella, Bella, and Olivia, pairing clothing with wings for their palace runway. Give each participant a finished look before completing the group's show preparations.

pages.title: Christmas Survival
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on festive shooting battles in Christmas Survival. Choose single-player or multiplayer play and enter one of the available game modes. Move, crouch, reload, and pick up firearms, then use the weapons and armor shop to prepare for further encounters.

pages.title: Head Sports Volleyball
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Play a compact volleyball match in Head Sports Volleyball. Choose a character and adjust settings such as the court, weather, computer difficulty, and match length. Move, jump, and strike the ball to earn points against the opponent during the selected match.

pages.title: Dumb Ways To Die Original
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep a cast of accident-prone characters alive in Dumb Ways To Die Original. React to a sequence of short minigames, following each challenge's action before the available moment passes. Successful play adds more characters to the collection gathered at the train station.

pages.title: Honda CRV Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six vehicle pictures in Honda CRV Puzzle. Choose a layout containing sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces, then reconnect the scattered sections. Match the vehicle and background details until the selected Honda CR-V image is restored.

pages.title: Classic Car Parking 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Maneuver a vintage vehicle into parking spaces in Classic Car Parking 3D. Steer with the driving keys and use the handbrake to control the final approach. Rotate the camera with the mouse when another angle helps judge the car's position within the layout.

pages.title: Bricks
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: Keep the ball in play while clearing walls of blocks in Bricks. Move the paddle left or right to return the ball toward the remaining targets. Collect effects such as a steel ball or laser and remove every brick to advance to another phase.

pages.title: Roll M Ball
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Balance a rolling ball in Roll M Ball. Adjust its movement to avoid obstacles and keep it from falling, gathering coins along the route. Spend the collected currency on options such as additional lives or a protective shield for later attempts.

pages.title: C Couple Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together vehicle photographs in C Couple Cars Puzzle. Pick one of six images and select from four piece counts between sixteen and one hundred. Connect sections of bodywork and background until the chosen car picture is complete.

pages.title: Pizza Slices
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Complete circular pizzas in Pizza Slices. Place the incoming slices into available circles, choosing spaces where their segments can fit. Filling a whole pizza clears it and adds to the score, while running out of suitable positions ends the attempt.

pages.title: Road Of Rampage
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Turn a vehicle into a fighting machine in Road Of Rampage. Shoot enemies along a post-apocalyptic highway and destroy the opponents blocking the road. Improve the vehicle between encounters to support its weapons and continue the battle through the wasteland.

pages.title: Alien Planet 3D Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight science-fiction enemies in Alien Planet 3D Shooter. Explore first-person encounters with different weapons, defeating threats to advance the character's level. Choose between two game modes and prepare for another set of opponents on the alien battlefield.

pages.title: Classic Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble a collection of older vehicles in Classic Cars Puzzle. Choose among six pictures and four difficulty settings, ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces. Match the scattered image sections to restore each car and the scene surrounding it.

pages.title: Odd One Out
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Find the item that differs from the rest in Odd One Out. Examine the displayed group and select the detail that does not belong with its neighbors. Compare the available choices carefully before moving on to another visual comparison.

pages.title: Ice Queen Brain Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Assist with a fictional emergency operation in Ice Queen Brain Doctor. Prepare the patient, apply anesthesia, and use the available tools during the brain-treatment sequence. Remove the strange objects and germs revealed by the procedure to complete the queen's virtual care.

pages.title: Russian Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Restore vehicle images in Russian Cars Jigsaw. Choose one of six photographs and a layout with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Use the car's outlines and surrounding details to reconnect the scattered sections into the completed picture.

pages.title: EG Candy Farm
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Run a candy-making operation in EG Candy Farm. Work as a harvester and move through the production and packaging activities for the sweets. Continue processing the candy to complete the factory tasks presented during the game.

pages.title: Christmas Number Crunch Rounding
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Combine arithmetic judgments with matching in Christmas Number Crunch Rounding. Decide whether each rounding statement is correct, then crunch the appropriate festive pieces. Use those decisions to create matches and clear the board while checking both the numbers and the tile arrangement.

pages.title: Minecaves 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Collect gemstones while finding a way through underground mazes in Minecaves 2. Plan a route around traps and monsters, picking up the valuables along the way. Reach the exit to leave the current cave and continue exploring the next puzzle.

pages.title: Math Test
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Answer multiplication questions under a sixty-second limit in Math Test. Check each expression and choose its correct result before moving to the next problem. Build as many accurate answers as possible while the countdown determines how long the attempt lasts.

pages.title: Jenner Lip Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give three celebrity-inspired characters a beauty treatment in Jenner Lip Doctor. Help Gigi, Kylie, and Kendall through the lip-care session, using the available items to complete their spa visit. Work on each character's appearance before finishing the treatment sequence.

pages.title: Barbie's Fairy style
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create a fantasy outfit in Barbie's Fairy style. Choose fairy-themed clothing and decorations for Barbie's evening look, comparing the available pieces as you work. Complete the styling with the details you want her to wear when meeting her friends.

pages.title: AdventureIsland
pages.creator: sandeep m
pages.description: Help Joe search for his missing brother in AdventureIsland. Explore islands, collect bananas, and complete the tasks needed to reach farther locations. Look for treasure during the journey while continuing the monkey's search for Eric across the wilderness.

pages.title: Tap Neon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Move past a scrolling field of hazards in Tap Neon. Touch the screen to direct the character left or right, choosing gaps between the approaching obstacles. Keep moving without a collision to extend the attempt and improve the high score.

pages.title: Pimi Jumpers
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Jump through a fantasy world in Pimi Jumpers. Guide the character along the route, gather coins, and complete the missions assigned to each stage. Unlock more progress and character options while working toward the remaining stars and treasures.

pages.title: Ice Princess Modeling Carrer
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Help Anna prepare for a modeling appearance in Ice Princess Modeling Carrer. Work on the character's makeover and choose clothing for the fashion show. Coordinate the available beauty and wardrobe options to complete her look before she steps into the modeling role.
